en: Job 19

p.src: 1  Then Job answered,

en: Then Job answered,
u.src: 1  Then Job answered,

p.src: 2  “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?

ja: あなたがたはいつまで
en: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?
u.src: 2  “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?

p.src: 3  You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

en: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.
u.src: 3  You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

p.src: 4  If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

ja: ちを犯したのなら、 その
en: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.
u.src: 4  If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

p.src: 5  If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,

en: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,
u.src: 5  If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,

p.src: 6  know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.

en: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
u.src: 6  know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.

p.src: 7  “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.

en: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
u.src: 7  “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.

p.src: 8  He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.

en: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
u.src: 8  He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.

p.src: 9  He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

en: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
u.src: 9  He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

p.src: 10  He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.

en: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.
u.src: 10  He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.

p.src: 11  He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.

en: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.
u.src: 11  He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.

p.src: 12  His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

en: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.
u.src: 12  His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

p.src: 13  “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

ja: から完全に離れ去った。
en: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
u.src: 13  “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

p.src: 14  My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.

en: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.
u.src: 14  My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.

p.src: 15  Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.

ja: には、私はよそ者である。
en: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.
u.src: 15  Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.

p.src: 16  I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.

en: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.
u.src: 16  I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.

p.src: 17  My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

ja: は同じ母から生まれた
en: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.
u.src: 17  My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

p.src: 18  Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

en: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.
u.src: 18  Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

p.src: 19  All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

en: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.
u.src: 19  All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

p.src: 20  My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

en: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
u.src: 20  My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

p.src: 21  “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.

ja: 私をあわれんでくれ。私をあわれんでくれ、私の友たちよ。
en: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.
u.src: 21  “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.

p.src: 22  Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

ja: のように私を追い詰め、 私の
en: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
u.src: 22  Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

p.src: 23  “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

ja: されたらよいのに。 ああ、それが書物に刻み込まれたらよいのに。
en: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
u.src: 23  “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

p.src: 24  That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!

ja: に岩に彫り込まれたらよいのに。
en: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
u.src: 24  That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!

p.src: 25  But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

ja: たれることを知っている。
en: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
u.src: 25  But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

p.src: 26  After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,

ja: にも、 その時、私はこの
en: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,
u.src: 26  After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,

p.src: 27  whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.

en: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.
u.src: 27  whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.

p.src: 28  If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,

ja: もしあなたがたが『どうやって
うなら、 事の根源が私の内にあるのだから、
en: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,
u.src: 28  If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,

p.src: 29  be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”

ja: をもたらすからだ。 そうすれば、裁きがあると
en: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
u.src: 29  be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
